body:
Partial implementation of #16: batch recovery and ToolCallStream share one incremental source intake, recognizer, governor, finalizer and event schedule. Complete admitted source is retained; refusal before complete capture publishes no prefix, while the digest covers every supplied byte. Healthy semantic-invalid requests retain their exact source.

Live content follows actual opener/marker ownership and normalization barriers. At EOF, structural native origins correlate selected and genuinely competing readings, including ambiguity Reject. Shared starts, canonical names, raw argument prefixes and authentic ordered revisions require actual native and semantic agreement. Final numbering and provenance differences stop at call end; typed parameters and completion require whole-call agreement. Silent edits participate before omission. A governed call-local witness index removes repeated full-ledger scans while preserving all matching witnesses and refusal behavior.

The source now exposes cached held_bytes(), candidate_bytes() and hold_back_bound(). Counts distinguish finite lexical/UTF-8 holdback from actual candidate ownership, unpublished typed payloads, settled semantic frames and suppressed content. Reasoning publication retires text ownership while retaining embedded semantic spans; historical routing metadata and receipt storage alone do not count. The bound includes UTF-8 carry and scalar backoff for custom continuation-byte markers. Cursor history identities preserve unvisited payloads sharing an end offset. Equal-rank native phases, typed ancestry summaries and governed finite interval coverage drive the same batch and streaming byte fold. Getters allocate nothing, charge no Work and do not observe a shared cancellation request until a mutable operation does. Explicit cancellation and observed refusal drop interpretation owners and clear counts while preserving the source/digest contract.

Pending reports now use reusable source identities and two indexed min-heaps, one for all reports and one for their candidate subset. Each payload remains single-owned in offset/phase/arrival dispatch order. Source/arrival keys preserve duplicate origins and arbitrary insertion/removal; free slots bound arena growth by concurrent queue size. Checked sifts, endpoint validation, replacement minima, storage and actual Work are prepared before queue mutation. Compact paths replay without further admission. Complete metadata assertions cover preparation, application and retirement within the existing reservation. Consuming EOF retains all index backing throughout the ordered drain and position processing, strips handles before ready buffers, and retires the index only after successful empty dispatch. Refusal preserves backing until remaining handles drop. No budget or acceptance threshold changes; runtime resource success remains unverified.

Recovery now reuses source boundaries certified by its successful UTF-8 byte fold, exact same-snapshot cutoff evidence, and an affine coverage basis invalidated by interval-union growth. The frontier memo retains the raw marker coordinate on both hit and miss, avoiding a repeated marker-table lookup. Engine thread-minimum aggregation activates only on the first actual ownership query with a fully admitted survivor scan; native ownership phases and interpretation always run. Actual executed work and retained metadata remain admitted, with explicit snapshot, arithmetic, subset and refusal checks. These changes remove redundant computation; fixed-budget success remains for automatic CI to establish.

For a verified resynchronizing cohort, ordinary grouped programs can now finish settlement after native byte processing and the first merge. Paid guards establish one live first-call owner, matching failure boundary and no pending side work; every current winner keeps its PC, history, rank and source. Only the idempotent second merge and other proved no-op suffix work are skipped. Exact current minima publish through the usual invalidation path. EOF and guard failures use normal settlement, including the actual qualification cost; no target, interpretation, cursor processing or budget is removed.

Inserted-wrapper lookahead now uses one compiled transition table with two exact priority projections for the final call/result programs. The shared trie/matcher constructor preserves ordinary longest-match behavior. It builds each dense transition row by copying its finalized failure row, then writing only actual sorted child edges; construction Work changes with this reduced computation, including explicit copied-cell and queue-relocation admission. This caller selects the earliest original token among simultaneous suffix matches, preserving filtered literal openers, local reasoning markers and closer spelling order independently for each program. Exact terminal replay retains duplicate priorities and keeps each program's private tokens invisible to the other. Complete typed construction phases retain the actual final, caller and private metadata owners through construction and every refusal. Runtime reuses the trail's phase-specific cursor, resets it at native rewind and feeds protocol-suffix bytes before line decisions. It removes repeated spelling-vector construction and literal scans while preserving whitespace, source, history, fence and EOF behavior. Original compilation and request budgets stay unchanged; constructor and runtime sufficiency remain unverified.


Validation: complete independent design/source reviews, formatting/prose/diff checks and normal hooks pass for the published units. Automatic run 41770402860 at 41b77cd compiles the corrected metadata assertions, then corpus evaluation refuses Work during built-in grammar preparation before runtime qualification. The source-reviewed row-copy/sparse-child correction at 21a7fe8 awaits fresh automatic qualification. Its full caller metadata remains admitted at 448 bytes, with every typed assertion and original compilation/request budget retained. Preceding 1490aa9 automatic Windows compiles and passes the adapted typed-minimum case, expanded D7 behavior, unchanged resync bound, argument budget and per-call competition. Held/closed still exhaust one million Work at observed peaks 1,289,932 and 757,736; depth, five cost checks, Exact, usage and digest acceptance remain open. A complete held feed requires at least 1,344,000 charged bytes under the current queue/arena/heaps/blocked ownership, so the observed held run stopped during feed; its peak is not a scratch limit. Preceding ab36a03 corpus compiles metadata assertions on 64-bit Linux and passes correction evaluation and the argument-work bound. It completes one-MiB Qwen at 40,913,882 Work and DeepSeek v3.1 at 49,313,042, then the next DeepSeek v3 invocation refuses before usage printing; two scale cases fail. WASM and packaging qualification pass preceding sources. Current usage/hash captures need complete observed comparison. The independent scratch-destruction prerequisite is tracked in #170 / PR #171 and is not yet adopted into this branch. No local compilation, tests, replay, probes, helper-check execution or manual CI dispatch/rerun ran, and no full gate pass or merge readiness is claimed.

The full #16 contract remains open: maximal live semantic prefix, counter runtime/resource qualification, Clone, constrained-decoding queries, semantic revisions, incremental emitters, CLI streaming, MCP progress and complete failure/fuzz/portable qualification. This draft does not close the parent or claim full D6, D7 or D19 completion.

References #16.
